purpose: Quantify and reconstruct the <=1000 JPY prior-close eligibility on the historical nominal price scale instead of Yahoo's present-day split-adjusted scale.

source_daily.known_behavior: Yahoo quote OHLC remains split-adjusted even with auto_adjust=False; run80 did not persist split events.

split_source.no_price_refetch_use: OHLC returned during the actions query must not replace frozen run80 OHLC.

reconstruction.formula: pit_price(date) = frozen_split_adjusted_price(date) * product(split_ratio for split_event_date > date and <= frozen_daily_max_date)
reconstruction.volume_rule: do not apply future split factor to frozen volume in V46; measure price-threshold leakage separately
reconstruction.split_on_signal_day: included when restoring previous-day close because event_date > previous_day

outputs: current-adjusted vs PIT prior-close ratio examples
hard_fail: split download coverage below 95% of frozen daily symbols
restrictions: No strategy returns, model scores, V44 replacement outcomes, or 2026 returns are used to choose a reconstruction.
Do not launch while Yahoo-heavy V44/V20 fetches are active.
V46 quantifies eligibility only; it does not claim the final survivorship-free universe because run80 is based on the 2026-09-11 current-listed JPX snapshot.
next_if_material: Build V47 PIT-eligible Consensus rerun: reconstruct PIT log_price, rebuild monitor_dates from PIT prior-close, fetch required 1H, retrain from scratch, and re-evaluate under canonical next-open endpoint.
